about.title: What is
about.desc: ECM+ is an integrated Enterprise Content Management system that centralizes documents, content, meetings, and business processes in one platform, helping organizations streamline workflows, improve collaboration, and manage information efficiently.

featureDesc: Document Management: Create, upload, organize, and manage documents.
Document Types: Define document types with configurable information and fields.
File Management: Upload files, use templates, or create and edit documents within the system.
Version Control: Track changes, view previous versions, and restore older versions.
Document Sharing: Share documents internally or externally with controlled access.
Document Relations: Link documents with related correspondence, meetings, and processes.
Email Integration: Add files received through email directly to documents.
Search & Filtering: Find documents quickly using metadata, types, keywords, and filters.
Notes & Reminders: Add notes, reminders, and follow-up information.
Security & Permissions: Protect documents with flexible access controls and permissions.
Approval & Archiving: Manage document approvals and archive completed documents.
Correspondence Registration: Register incoming, outgoing, internal, and external correspondence.
Correspondence Types: Create configurable correspondence types with dynamic fields.
Routing & Distribution: Route correspondence to departments, employees, groups, or committees.
Response Management: Create, manage, and link responses to related correspondence.
Attachments: Add documents, templates, and email attachments to correspondence.
Tracking: Track correspondence status, actions, and processing history.
Notes & Reminders: Add notes, priorities, deadlines, and follow-up reminders.
Search & Filtering: Quickly find correspondence using advanced search and filters.
Security & Permissions: Control access based on roles and responsibilities.
Reports & Dashboard: Monitor correspondence activity, workload, and performance.
Meeting Creation: Create new meetings or link them to existing meeting series.
Meeting Details: Manage subjects, descriptions, dates, times, formats, and time zones.
Room & Online Meetings: Manage physical, online, and hybrid meetings.
Attendee Management: Add organizers, employees, groups, committees, and external participants.
Agenda Management: Create agendas, assign time slots, and designate minute takers.
Attachments: Add and manage meeting-related documents and files.
Task Management: Assign tasks, set priorities and deadlines, and track progress.
Invitations: Send and manage meeting invitations.
Voting: Create polls, voting options, and control eligible voters.
Attendance: Record and manage meeting attendance.
Meeting Reports: Generate, edit, and export detailed meeting reports.
Meeting Chat: Communicate through a dedicated meeting conversation.
Meeting Tracking: View, search, filter, and monitor all meetings.
Process Design: Design and configure business processes and workflows.
Workflow Automation: Automate tasks and process steps based on predefined rules.
Task Management: Assign, prioritize, track, and manage workflow tasks.
Approvals: Create multi-level review and approval workflows.
Business Rules: Define conditions and rules to control process flow.
Task Assignment: Assign activities to employees, groups, departments, or roles.
Notifications: Send automatic notifications, reminders, and deadline alerts.
Document Integration: Connect documents and correspondence to business processes.
Process Tracking: Monitor process status and track every workflow activity.
Audit Trail: Maintain a complete history of actions, decisions, and approvals.
Reports & Analytics: Monitor process performance, workload, delays, and completion rates.

dms.moduleDesc: Archive, organize, and control access to every document your organization holds

archiveDocuments.featureShortDesc: Manage, search, and securely access archived documents.
featureDesc: Archived Documents: View and manage all archived documents.
Search & Filters: Quickly find documents using advanced search and filtering options.
Document Details: View document information, metadata, and related records.
Preview: Preview documents and their attachments directly within the system.
Version History: View previous versions and restore an earlier version when needed.
Document Relations: Access documents and correspondence related to the archived document.
Workflow & Procedures: Track procedures and workflows associated with the document.
Sharing: Share documents internally or externally based on access permissions.
Download & Export: Download or export documents when permitted.
Notes & Reminders: Add and manage notes and reminders related to documents.
Security & Permissions: Control document access and protect sensitive information.
Restore: Return archived documents to active document management.
Delete: Permanently delete documents according to permissions and retention policies.

archivedDocumentsExplorer.featureShortDesc: Browse, organize, and manage documents through folders.
featureDesc: Folder Management: Create, rename, move, and delete folders.
Document Organization: Organize documents within folders and subfolders.
Folder Navigation: Browse folders and access their contents easily.
File Management: Upload, move, copy, and manage files within folders.
Sharing: Share folders and their contents with authorized users.
Access Control: Manage permissions for folders and their contents.
Search: Search for documents and folders within the explorer.
Preview: Preview supported documents and files directly from the explorer.

search.featureShortDesc: Find documents quickly using powerful search and filters.
featureDesc: Global Search: Search across documents and archived content.
Keyword Search: Find documents using keywords and phrases.
Advanced Filters: Filter results by type, date, status, classification, and other fields.
Metadata Search: Search using document metadata and custom fields.
Saved Searches: Save frequently used search criteria for quick access.
Search Results: View relevant documents with key information and metadata.
Sorting: Sort results by date, name, type, relevance, and other criteria.

documentTypes.featureShortDesc: Create and configure document types and their required information.
featureDesc: Type Management: Create, edit, and manage document types.
Custom Fields: Define fields and information required for each type.
Type Classification: Organize documents according to predefined categories.
Field Configuration: Configure field types, requirements, and validation.
Templates: Associate document templates with specific document types.
Permissions: Control access to document types and their configurations.
Type Status: Enable or disable document types when needed.

aclPolicies.featureShortDesc: Control document access through flexible permission policies.
featureDesc: Access Policies: Create and manage document access policies.
User Permissions: Grant or restrict access for specific users.
Group Permissions: Assign permissions to groups, departments, or roles.
Permission Levels: Control actions such as viewing, editing, sharing, downloading, and deleting.
Inheritance: Apply permissions across folders and their contents.
Access Restrictions: Restrict sensitive documents to authorized users.
Policy Management: Update and manage access policies as organizational requirements change.

retentionRules.featureShortDesc: Define how long documents are retained and when they are archived or disposed.
featureDesc: Retention Policies: Create and manage document retention rules.
Retention Periods: Define how long documents should be retained.
Document Types: Apply retention rules to specific document types or categories.
Automatic Archiving: Automatically archive documents based on defined rules.
Expiration Management: Identify documents approaching or reaching their retention limit.
Disposal Rules: Define actions for documents after their retention period.
Compliance: Support organizational and regulatory document retention requirements.

sharedDocuments.featureShortDesc: Access and manage documents shared with users and teams.
featureDesc: Shared Documents: View documents shared with you or your teams.
Document Sharing: Share documents with authorized users and groups.
Access Control: Define permissions for shared documents.
Shared Folders: Share folders and their contents with selected users.
Collaboration: Allow authorized users to work with shared documents.
Activity Tracking: Track sharing and document activities.
Remove Access: Revoke access to previously shared documents.

recycleBin.featureShortDesc: Manage deleted documents and restore them when needed.
featureDesc: Deleted Documents: View documents and files moved to the recycle bin.
Restore: Restore deleted documents to their original location.
Permanent Delete: Permanently remove documents when authorized.
Search & Filters: Find deleted documents using search and filtering options.
Deletion Details: View information about when and by whom a document was deleted.
Bulk Actions: Restore or permanently delete multiple documents.
Access Control: Restrict recycle bin actions based on user permissions.

cms.moduleDesc: Manage, organize, and track incoming and outgoing correspondence through an integrated correspondence management system.

settings.featureShortDesc: Manage the basic settings and data used by the correspondence system.
featureDesc: Correspondence Types: Create and manage correspondence types and their required fields and information.
Correspondence Statuses: Create and manage correspondence statuses used throughout the system.
Confidentiality Levels: Add and manage confidentiality levels for correspondence.
Priority Levels: Add and manage correspondence priority levels.
Tags: Create and manage tags used to classify and organize correspondence.
Receiving Methods: Define and manage the methods used to receive correspondence.

externalEntities.featureShortDesc: Manage external entities used for sending and receiving correspondence.
featureDesc: Add External Entity: Create and add external entities that the organization communicates with.
Basic Information: Store the entity name, description, address, and image.
Contacts: Add and manage contacts associated with each external entity.
Entity Management: View, edit, and manage external entity information.

correspondenceInbox.featureShortDesc: Manage incoming, outgoing, draft, and completed correspondence.
featureDesc: Incoming Correspondence: View and manage incoming correspondence and follow up on related actions.
Outgoing Correspondence: View and manage correspondence that has been sent.
Drafts: Save and manage correspondence that has not been completed or sent.
Completed Correspondence: Access correspondence for which all required actions have been completed.
Correspondence Actions: Perform available actions on correspondence based on its status and user permissions.

addCorrespondence.featureShortDesc: Create a new correspondence and enter all related information and attachments.
featureDesc: Basic Information: Enter the basic information of the correspondence.
Correspondence Type Information: Enter the information and fields specific to the selected correspondence type.
Attachments: Add files and documents related to the correspondence.
Email Attachments: Add files and attachments received through email.

mms.moduleDesc: Manage meetings, committees, tasks, and all related activities through an integrated meeting management platform.

performanceIndicators.featureShortDesc: Monitor meeting and task performance through clear statistics and indicators.
featureDesc: Meeting Statistics: View personal meeting statistics and overall meeting statistics.
Total Meetings: View the total number of meetings.
Meeting Status: Monitor upcoming, completed, draft, cancelled, and rescheduled meetings.
Task Inbox: View total, pending, in-progress, completed, and overdue tasks.
Weekly Meetings: View meetings scheduled during the current week.
Recent Meetings: Access recently created or completed meetings.
Calendar: View and manage meetings through the calendar.
Scheduling: Schedule meetings by selecting suitable dates and times.

settings.featureShortDesc: Manage buildings, meeting rooms, and related meeting series.
featureDesc: Add Building: Add buildings where meetings can be held.
Add Room: Add meeting rooms, link each room to its building, and enter its details.
Room Details: Define room information, location within the building, and capacity.
Related Meeting Series: Create and manage meeting series to link related meetings.

committees.featureShortDesc: Create and manage committees and their members for meeting participation.
featureDesc: Create Committee: Create a new committee and add its name, description, and members.
Committee Members: Add and manage committee members.
Committee List: View available committees when selecting meeting participants.
Invite Committee: Select an entire committee and add it to the meeting attendee list.

meetings.featureShortDesc: Create, manage, and monitor meetings and all related activities.
featureDesc: Create Meeting: Create a new meeting or link it to another meeting within a related meeting series.
Basic Information: Enter the meeting subject, description, date, start time, end time, meeting type, and time zone.
Meeting Type: Define whether the meeting is physical or online.
Physical Meetings: Select an available room and view its location within the building and capacity.
Online Meetings: Select a meeting platform and automatically create a meeting link or add one manually.
Organizer: The meeting creator is automatically assigned as the organizer, with the option to change the organizer.
Attendees: Add employees, employee groups, committee members, or external participants.
Agenda: Add meeting agenda items, assign presenters, and define the duration of each item.
Attachments: Add and manage meeting-related files with editing capabilities.
Tasks: Add tasks related to the meeting and define task details, assignee, priority, and due date.
Task Management: Delete created tasks, view task details, and update the status of the user's own tasks.
Meeting Invitations: Send meeting invitations to participants through the system.
Voting: Create a vote, add its name and description, define voting options, and select eligible voters.
Attendance Confirmation: Confirm participant attendance after the meeting.
Meeting Report: Create a meeting report and add details and outcomes from the meeting.
Attendance Signatures: Add signatures from selected participants to confirm their attendance.
Report Export: Export the meeting report as a PDF file.
Report Editing: Add and edit information within the meeting report.
Meeting Chat: Provide a dedicated conversation for meeting participants while keeping the conversation as part of the meeting record.
Meeting Tracking: View all meetings, access their details, and filter them based on meeting information.

taskInbox.featureShortDesc: Track user-related tasks and manage their status.
featureDesc: Task List: View all tasks related to meetings.
Task Status: View tasks that have not started, are in progress, or are completed.
Status Updates: Users can update the status of their own tasks only.
Task Permissions: Users can view all tasks but cannot modify the status of tasks assigned to other users.

bpm.moduleDesc: Design, automate, and monitor business processes and workflows across the organization.

processManagement.featureShortDesc: Create, manage, and monitor business processes and workflows.
featureDesc: Process Creation: Create and configure business processes and workflows.
Process Configuration: Define process data, settings, and business rules.
Process Assignment: Assign processes to users, groups, departments, or roles.
Process Tracking: Monitor the status and progress of each process.
Process Management: Manage and update processes according to user permissions.

workflowDesigner.featureShortDesc: Design and configure workflows using a visual interface.
featureDesc: Visual Design: Build workflows using a visual design interface.
Workflow Steps: Add tasks, approvals, decisions, and process stages.
Step Connections: Define transitions and paths between workflow steps.
Conditions: Define conditions that control the process path.
Workflow Rules: Define rules that control workflow execution.
Validation: Validate workflows before activating them.

tasks.featureShortDesc: Manage and track tasks generated by business processes.
featureDesc: Task Creation: Create tasks associated with process activities.
Task Assignment: Assign tasks to users, groups, or departments.
Task Details: Define task descriptions, instructions, and required actions.
Priority: Set the priority of each task.
Due Dates: Define deadlines for task completion.
Task Status: Track pending, in-progress, completed, and overdue tasks.
Task Actions: Perform available actions according to user permissions.
Task History: View actions and changes made to each task.

approvals.featureShortDesc: Manage review and approval steps within business processes.
featureDesc: Approval Steps: Add approval stages to business processes.
Approver Assignment: Assign approval steps to users, groups, or roles.
Multi-Level Approvals: Configure multiple approval levels.
Approve & Reject: Allow authorized users to approve or reject requests.
Return for Revision: Return requests for correction or completion.
Approval History: Maintain a history of approval and rejection decisions and responsible users.

businessRules.featureShortDesc: Define rules and conditions that control process behavior.
featureDesc: Rule Creation: Create and manage business rules.
Conditions: Define conditions based on process data.
Conditional Routing: Automatically route processes based on defined conditions.
Actions: Execute specific actions when conditions are met.
Rule Management: Enable, disable, and update business rules.
Rule Validation: Validate rules before applying them.

notifications.featureShortDesc: Keep users informed about tasks, actions, and process changes.
featureDesc: Task Notifications: Notify users when a new task is assigned to them.
Status Notifications: Notify users when the process status changes.
Approval Notifications: Notify responsible users about pending approval requests.
Reminders: Send reminders for upcoming tasks and deadlines.
Overdue Alerts: Notify users about overdue tasks and processes.
Notification Settings: Define when notifications should be triggered.

processDocuments.featureShortDesc: Manage documents associated with business processes and workflows.
featureDesc: Document Attachments: Add documents and files to process activities.
Document Access: Access related documents directly from the process.
Document Creation: Create documents as part of a process.
Document Integration: Link processes with documents and correspondence managed through DMS and CMS.
Document Tracking: Track documents and related activities throughout the process.
Access Control: Control access to process-related documents.

processMonitoring.featureShortDesc: Monitor processes, tasks, and workflow execution stages.
featureDesc: Active Processes: View processes that are currently running.
Process Status: Monitor the current status of each process.
Task Monitoring: View tasks associated with processes and their statuses.
Process Progress: Monitor process progress across different stages.
Delay Detection: Identify delayed or blocked processes and tasks.
Process Timeline: View the sequence of actions and activities performed during the process.

auditTrail.featureShortDesc: Maintain a complete history of actions and decisions performed during processes.
featureDesc: Activity History: Record actions performed during process execution.
User Actions: Record actions performed by users.
Status Changes: Record process and task status changes.
Approvals & Decisions: Record approval, rejection, and related decisions.
Timestamps: Record when each action was performed.
Process History: Maintain the complete history of process activities and actions.

processDashboard.featureShortDesc: Monitor process performance, tasks, and organizational workload.
featureDesc: Process Statistics: View process statistics and overall activity.
Active Processes: Monitor currently running processes.
Task Overview: View pending, in-progress, completed, and overdue tasks.
Performance Metrics: Monitor process execution times and completion rates.
Workload: Monitor task distribution across users and departments.
Reports & Analytics: Analyze process performance, delays, and bottlenecks.

footer.desc: Centralize your organization's documents, meetings, and workflows in one connected platform.
